responsibility: Implements the common runtime support for analyzer API-usage state machines. This file provides basic helpers such as pointer classification, concrete implementations of state_machine and state dumping/JSON support, sm_context accessors shared by checkers, and the factory routine that instantiates and filters the enabled checker set (malloc, FILE, fd, taint, sensitive, signal, va_list, and test machines) for a given analyzer run.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic state-machine framework declared in sm.h, including concrete helper routines, state/state_machine dumping and JSON support, sm_context accessors, and checker-factory logic that builds the enabled machines at runtime; the header mainly defines the abstract interfaces and hooks that individual checkers implement.
